pattern_name: Em Dash Overuse and Paired Bracketing

cases.input: The term is primarily promoted by Dutch institutions—not by the people themselves. You don't say "Netherlands, Europe" as an address—yet this mislabeling continues—even in official documents.
cases.notes: Meetup 2026-05-26 (1/6/2). Em-dash density needs count-based regex not substring match; substring-flagging would punish legitimate punctuation.

cases.input: The report—which covered three continents and twelve case studies—concluded that demand had shifted.
cases.notes: Meetup 2026-05-26 (8/1/0 endorse true-neg). Single paired em-dash = skill doc's explicit 'earned bracket' exception.
